name: aerotrack-demo
description: 45 s demo video of aerotrack, rendered with Remotion from a tracked export (aerotrack demo-export)

scripts.render:github: remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/aerotrack-demo.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/aerotrack-demo-github.mp4
